title: Document Analysis - General
application: Upload and interpret or summarize multiple documents
description: Use AI to interpret long documents, summarize content, and identify key insights.
business_value: Reduced manual work, consistent formatting, enhanced research efficiency, improved compliance readiness.
data_sources: Internal research; regulatory filings; compliance manuals; contracts
suggested_roles: analyst; business strategist; compliance officer; CEO; customer manager
example_prompts: Summarize this document in simple terms.;Highlight key insights from this file.;Extract all risks from this policy.;Explain this section in plain English.;Compare these documents for consistency.

title: Document Q&A Chat
description: Use AI to chat with a document, answer questions, and retrieve specific insights.
business_value: Faster document understanding, efficient information extraction, reduced search time.
data_sources: 10-K forms; financial reports; white papers; client commentary
suggested_roles: analyst; CEO; product manager; business strategist; customer manager
example_prompts: Answer questions about this document.;What does section 3 mean?;Summarize the main risks.;Extract financial highlights.;Explain this paragraph to me.

title: Document Comparison
description: Use AI to compare documents, detect changes, and highlight differences.
business_value: Quick identification of changes, improved version control, enhanced due diligence.
data_sources: Contract versions; policy updates; financial statements
suggested_roles: compliance officer; analyst; business strategist; operations lead
example_prompts: Compare these two versions.;Highlight all updated sections.;Summarize changes between draft and final.;Identify discrepancies across documents.;What changed in version 2024?

title: Document Generation - Compliance Reports
description: Use AI to fill templates and produce compliance-ready reports.
business_value: Simplified drafting, improved formatting consistency, reduced compliance preparation time.
data_sources: Internal templates; regulatory requirements; business data; compliance guidelines
suggested_roles: compliance officer; operations; business strategist; CEO
example_prompts: Generate a compliance summary from this document.;Fill this template with key compliance sections.;Draft a regulatory disclosure.;Create a structured audit report.;Reformat this into a compliance-ready format.

title: Document Generation - Client Communications
description: Use AI to write professional and client-ready documents.
business_value: Faster writing, consistent tone, improved communication quality.
data_sources: Client info; communication templates; brand guidelines
suggested_roles: sales; customer manager; CEO; product manager
example_prompts: Draft a client update email.;Generate a client meeting summary.;Write commentary based on these points.;Convert notes into a client-ready format.;Improve tone for professional communication.

title: Report Summarization
description: Use AI to summarize reports in different tones or personas.
business_value: Quick executive summaries, tailored messaging for different audiences.
example_prompts: Summarize this report for executives.;Create a bullet-point summary.;Explain this for a non-technical audience.;Extract insights for investors.;Summarize from a PM perspective.

title: Meeting Agenda Generation
description: Use AI to fill agenda templates using topics or meeting goals.
business_value: Faster agenda creation, standardized meeting structure.
suggested_roles: operations lead; sales; product manager; CEO
example_prompts: Generate an agenda from these topics.;Fill the agenda template.;Create a client meeting agenda.;Build an agenda for internal update.;Summarize topics into an agenda.

title: Meeting Prep - Slide Feedback
application: Get AI feedback on slide content
description: Use AI to review slide content and provide actionable improvements.
business_value: Better slide quality, improved clarity and storytelling.
example_prompts: Review these slides for clarity.;Suggest improvements for this deck.;Rewrite unclear slide text.;Simplify these bullets.;Improve the narrative flow.

title: Meeting Rehearsal
description: Use AI to simulate Q&A sessions and rehearse presentations.
business_value: Improved confidence, better preparation, anticipated questions.
suggested_roles: sales; CEO; customer manager; product manager
example_prompts: Ask me tough questions as a client.;Simulate Q&A for this deck.;Give feedback on my explanation.;Act as an investor and ask questions.;Test my pitch for clarity.

title: Email Drafting
application: Generate emails based on key points
description: Use AI to write new emails based on purpose and audience.
suggested_roles: sales; CEO; HR; customer support; recruiter
example_prompts: Draft an email based on these points.;Write a client follow-up email.;Generate a professional response.;Write a friendly but formal email.;Create an outreach email.

title: Email Editing
application: Improve clarity and tone of emails
description: Use AI to rephrase emails with better grammar and audience alignment.
business_value: Improved clarity, better tone, polished communication.
suggested_roles: all roles; recruiter; customer support; sales
example_prompts: Rewrite this email professionally.;Improve tone for this email.;Make this shorter and clearer.;Correct grammar and phrasing.;Adjust tone for executives.

title: Email Optimization
application: Optimize email clarity, tone, and structure
description: Use AI to improve communication effectiveness.
business_value: More productive communication, consistent brand voice.
example_prompts: Improve tone and readability.;Optimize this email.;Rewrite to sound more confident.;Shorten this message.;Make this more persuasive.

title: Power BI Assistance
application: Help with measures, DAX, dashboard building
description: Use AI to generate DAX formulas and BI logic.
business_value: Faster BI work, less IT dependency.
example_prompts: Write a DAX measure for this.;Fix this DAX error.;Create a dashboard logic.;Explain this BI concept.;Generate measure from these requirements.

title: Excel Formula Creation
application: Generate Excel formulas from natural language
description: Use AI to translate business logic into Excel formulas.
suggested_roles: analyst; operations lead; finance; business strategist
example_prompts: Write an Excel formula for this.;Fix this Excel error.;Convert this logic into a formula.;Explain how this formula works.;Generate nested formula.

title: Coding Assistant - Python/SQL/R
description: Use AI to help write or correct code snippets.
example_prompts: Fix this Python error.;Write SQL for this logic.;Generate Python snippet.;Explain this code.;Optimize this function.

title: Software How-To Assistant
description: Use AI to guide users through workflows & automations.
example_prompts: Guide me step-by-step.;How do I automate this task?;Walk me through this workflow.;Explain how to do this in Power BI.;How to use this tool?
